name: ChartContainer
usage: Wrapping a custom graphic (a map, a diagram) so that it matches the other charts of a dashboard

props.name: children
props.description: The graphic, sized to fill the body (`height` pixels high, as wide as the container).

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend items; the legend is shown from two items on (a single series is named by the title).

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description:
Keys of the legend items that are hidden (controlled). With `onHiddenKeysChange`, the legend items become
toggle buttons.

props.name: onHiddenKeysChange
props.description: Called with the new hidden keys when a legend item is toggled.

props.name: getTable
props.description:
Builds the same data as a table: when given, a "Chart / Table" switch appears in the top-right corner. It is
called only while the table view is shown, once, and again when this function changes: pass a stable function
(`useCallback`) that changes with the data. Long tables render only the rows in view.

props.name: empty
props.description: There is no data: shows the empty state (or the loading indicator while `loading`).

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.

props.name: description
props.description: A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at
this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous
graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.

props.name: error
props.description: Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).

props.name: plain
props.description: Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer.

types.name: ChartLegendItem
types.summary: An item of a chart legend.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Identity of the item: the key of the series (or slice) it stands for.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text of the item; shown as text, never interpreted as HTML.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Color: a position in the categorical palette, or `'muted'` for "Other" and de-emphasized series.

fields.name: marker
fields.description:
Shape of the marker, matching the mark of the graphic: a short line for lines, a dot for points, a square for
bars, areas and slices.

types.name: ChartTableData
types.summary: The data of the table view: columns and rows of already formatted texts.

fields.name: columns
fields.description: The columns, in order; the first one usually names the category, slice or cell.

types.name: ChartColorSlot
types.summary:
Position of a series in the categorical chart palette, from 1 to 8 (tokens `color-chart-1` … `color-chart-8`).
Pin it when the same entity appears in several charts, so that it keeps its color everywhere.

types.name: ChartTableColumn
types.summary: A column of the table view.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Key of the column in each row.

fields.name: numeric
fields.description: Right-aligned with tabular numbers (columns of values).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A custom graphic in the same frame as the other charts: title, description, states and a table view built from
the same data (`getTable`, called only when the table is shown). The graphic fills the body, which is `height`
pixels high.

examples.name: Legend
examples.title: Legend
examples.description:
Legend items with `onHiddenKeysChange` become toggle buttons; the graphic decides what hiding means. The
legend appears from two items on.
